# Welcome to Hazel Lane Allotments

Your plot is now registered in your name. Rent is due each October, and plots must be kept cultivated. Please read the rules below before you start work.

Water troughs are filled from April to September. Please use watering cans, not hoses, and close the trough lids after use. Bonfires are allowed only on the first weekend of each month, before 10 am.

The shed code is 4417. Tools in the shed are shared; please clean them and put them back. Contact the secretary, Priya Nair, on 07700 900412 with any questions.
